label: Basic
description: Basic popover. Best for the minimal anatomy: a title and a one line description, with no body or actions.

label: Opening Sides
description: Popovers on different sides. Best for one trigger per side in a grid, each opening a narrow panel on that side, moving to the other side when it does not fit.

label: Inline Form
description: Popover with a form. Best for a Dimensions heading over 2 label and input rows for width and height, with no submit button.

label: Alignment
description: Popover alignment. Best for 3 small buttons whose content-width panels line up with the start, centre or end of their trigger.

label: In Dialog
description: Popover inside a dialog. Best for a second layer in an open dialog: a button in its body opens a title and description panel.

label: Profile Card
description: Popover with a profile. Best for a person chip with avatar and handle that opens a bio card with follower counts and a Follow button.

label: Feature Pitch
description: Popover with custom content. Best for a feature pitch with a primary tinted header bar, a short explainer and Enable AI and Learn more buttons.

label: Media Preview
description: Popover with a media preview. Best for an edge to edge 16:9 image above a template name, a one line summary and 2 action buttons.

label: Relative Time
description: Relative time with time zones. Best for a relative time inside a sentence, behind a dashed underline, that opens the exact time in 3 zones.

label: Controls
description: Popover with controls. Best for an icon only settings button opening 2 labelled switches and a volume slider with a live percent readout.

label: Step Tour
description: Popover with steps. Best for a 4 step tour opening above its button, with a step counter and back and next arrows that stop at either end.
